checked_decisions.finding: Confirmed as Mission 10A ('Defend Amaterasu'): a target-elimination combat mission interrupted when a black machine (Akito's) and the Martian Successors surface from inside the Amaterasu facility; matches resource_id 6100 in the source dump.
Shirahime and the returning enemy force correctly linked to the prior mission; no new name proposal needed.
Two-clause warning (avoid pincer attack; nothing left but annihilation) compressed into one sentence without dropping either half.
Mission-fail template matches established corpus phrasing.
'Ryoko-sama'/'professional contractor' lines correctly kept generic; addressee (Ryoko) is settled two rows later by name, not invented early.
Kanchou (艦長) consistently rendered 'Captain' per orchestrator ruling.

'Enemy of Earth, enemy of Mokuren, enemy of every corruption in space... We are the Martian Successors!' correctly kept as a self-declaration (the Successors declaring themselves enemies of those three things), not reversed into a description of outside enemies. 'Mokuren' as 'Jovian Federation' matches encyclopedia_022's own rendering of the same abbreviation.
Block 13 correctly carried as a plain fact immediately followed by the bridge crew's own surprise that no such block exists in the records; no explanation invented.

Fullwidth-Latin interference text (OTIKA..., the exclamation-plus-spaces row, AKI TO...) kept verbatim as garbled build-up to the row 3278 recognition, per task instruction; not 'corrected' to spell AKITO early.
Honorific -san dropped from 'Akito-san' and 'Ryoko-san' consistently with the rest of the corpus's honorific-dropping convention; no meaning lost.

Archaic Martian Successors proclamation translated literally (Amatsukuni as 'the heavens', the Hisago/gourd pun kept literal); no idiomatic English proverb substituted without a source. Reviewed as a defensible literal rendering given no wiki attestation exists for this unique in-game text; see uncertainties below.

The 'it' being fought over (the Ruins Unit / Boson Jump black box) and the two speakers' opposed claims to it ('I will take it back' vs 'it is in my hands... I will kill you and take it back') are kept internally consistent and not reversed.

'Boson Jump' left as plain text on these rows because the source itself has no book() tag there (unlike row 3355); tag-fidelity rule correctly followed. Ryoko's exposition (ruins / Earth and Jupiter both after it / black box / true nature of the Hisago Plan) is not reordered or altered in meaning.
Source says '地球と木星' (Earth and Jupiter the planet), not '木連' (Mokuren/Jovian Federation); target correctly keeps 'Jupiter', not over-generalized to 'Jovian Federation'.

'Will you die in front of a woman?' and the doubled vocative 'Akito! You really are Akito' both kept as unnamed/repeated exactly as the source frames them; no name invented for the unnamed 'woman' (contextually Yurika) and no content dropped from the repeated name.

uncertainties.issue: Archaic proclamation is apparently unique to this game and unattested in any consulted wiki; the literal rendering (heavens/gourd) is defensible but the register and exact idiom remain a judgment call worth a second look if a source ever surfaces.

Speakers are untagged. Row 3291 ('Ruri... are you watching?') reads as Akito addressing Ruri Hoshino through a monitor; rows 3305-3306 and 3309 read as Ryoko (named at 3293-3295) reacting to seeing Yurika and Akito on screen and then echoing Akito's plea to Ruri. This is inference only; no speaker identity was written into any target.

Several praise/hunch/skill-observation lines have no explicit subject or addressee in the source; the existing renderings keep them generically applicable rather than naming a specific pilot, which is correct per the no-invented-subject rule but leaves the exact addressee unconfirmed.
